messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — Elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/streaming (canary: us-west-2). 5xx spike started ~1938199980. Affected: streaming handshake failures (count=124 in 3m).

maya: seeing this in prod-canary after SDK 1.9 rollout. clients failing to establish WS sessions. errors in client logs: `ERR_FRAME_HEADER_INVALID`

devon (oncall): jumping in. maya — can you paste example logs from the gateway + client handshake?

maya: sure — from gateway pod `stream-wn-02`:
```
2026-03-15T02:34:10Z ERROR handshake: invalid frame header: expected 24 got 18
2026-03-15T02:34:11Z WARN conn: client 10.2.3.14 dropped during handshake
```
client side (AcmeCorp dev):
```
[SDK 1.9] stream.connect() => handshake failed: frame type mismatch
stack: at net/stream/frame.js:42
```

devon: hmm. that looks like a frame format mismatch between SDK client and server runtime. @arjun any release notes in 1.9 about frame/proto changes?

arjun: 1.9 did a small change to client-side framing to support varint lengths for perf. I flagged it in the PR but maybe the server runtime didn't pick up the compatible parser. PR #4567 mentions optional varint.

lina: customer impact — two canary customers reported session drops: AcmeCorp (chat link) and NovaChat. Roughly 1.2% of streaming sessions failed in canary; latency unaffected for non-streaming.

devon: immediate mitigation: kill the 1.9 canary flag to stop new clients from pulling 1.9. Feature flag is `sdk_client_v1_9_canary`. Ops, please flip it now and confirm.

opsbot: received command. Executing toggle via FF service.

maya: @opsbot link to FF: https://ff.internal.redwood/flags/sdk_client_v1_9_canary

opsbot: toggled `sdk_client_v1_9_canary` -> OFF. Confirmed: no new assignations to 1.9.

jess: starting a rollback of the canary packages to 1.8.1 for the streaming-client group. I'll run the rollout job now.

jess: command:
```bash
./releases/rollout.sh --group streaming-client --version 1.8.1 --env canary --strategy restart
```

incident-bot: NOTE — rolling back package streaming-client -> 1.8.1 (canary). Job id: rb-20260315-01

sanjay: taking on-call handover from devon for follow-up (handing at 1938200100). devon — can you drop summary for next shift?

devon: handing over: root cause suspected client frame header change in 1.9 incompatible with runtime parser. Mitigation done: FF kill + canary rollback in progress. Monitoring error rate and session success. Next actions: patch server runtime to accept varint optional frame OR revert the optional encoding in client.

opsbot: rollout job rb-20260315-01: 3/3 pods updated to 1.8.1 in canary. Health checks passing.

devon: confirming metrics — error rate down from 4.3% to 0.08% in canary over last 3m. Good.

arjun: we should prepare a hotpatch plan. Two options: 1) server-side parser patch to accept both legacy and varint header formats (preferred for forward compatibility) 2) revert client 1.9 to legacy framing and cut 1.9.1. Which is faster?

maya: given customers already rolled to 1.9 in some clients, server patch likely faster. I'll open an internal ticket and assign to eng-runtime.

jess: created ticket INF-7896 "server: accept varint/legacy frame headers" and assigned to @eng-runtime. Link: https://jira.redwood/INF-7896

lina: Support alerted and drafting customer comms for AcmeCorp / NovaChat: outage description & temporary mitigation.

devon: quick postmortem notes (we'll expand):
- timeline: 1938199980 alert -> 1938200000 thread -> FF kill 1938200045 -> rollback complete 1938200160
- impact: canary only, two customers affected, session create 1.2% failure bucket, no data loss reported
- root cause hypothesis: optional varint frame encoding introduced client-side without server compatibility ensured
- mitigations: FF kill, canary rollback, server patch in progress

sanjay: I'll own monitoring and customer follow-up through the night. devon — handover confirmed.

devon: thanks all — I'll be available for runtime PR reviews.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — status: mitigated (canary rollback + FF kill). Final note: follow-up required: INF-7896 (runtime patch), and release checklist updated to require end-to-end handshake compatibility test for any framing/proto changes.

maya: agreed. also add a gating test in the e2e canary job that validates handshake from new client -> old runtime and vice-versa.

arjun: I'll draft a short customer note for enterprise contacts and send to PS + support.

jess: closing runbook task list, moving to monitoring watch for 2h. :white_check_mark:

sanjay: handing back to devon at 1938200365 — thanks everyone.
